newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber completes private placement.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber completes private placement.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said Friday it completed a $250 million private placement of senior notes.

The financing, combined with a planned bank credit facility which the company is negotiating with several financial institutions, will be used to fund Brooks Fiber's capital needs in its 44 markets, it said.
The notes pay interest semi-annually on June 1 and December 1 at a rate of 10 percent with a final maturity date of June 1, 2007, the company said.
Goldman, Sachs & Co, Salomon Brothers Inc and Merrill Lynch & Co were the placement agents for the financing, which closed May 29, 1997.
Brooks Fiber is a provider of competitive local telecommunications services.
